song_story.overview: XOXZ plays with the familiar shorthand 'XOXO' (hugs and kisses) but pushes it into stranger, more hypnotic territory — the lyrics describe closing your eyes, sinking into a kind of trance, and no longer being able to wake up from a fantasy the narrator has built for you. It's less a sweet love song and more a seductive, slightly unsettling dream-logic pursuit, in keeping with IVE's habit of dressing confident desire in a striking, high-concept visual and lyrical world.
song_story.cultural_root: The song leans on the aesthetic of 최면 (choemyeon, hypnosis) and 꿈 (kkum, dream) as metaphors for total desire and control — wanting someone so completely that the song frames it as pulling them into an inescapable trance rather than a mutual, grounded relationship. This fits a broader trend in fourth-generation K-pop girl-group concepts, where longing and attraction get expressed through imagery of possession, spells, or dreams rather than plain affection, giving an ordinary crush song a darker, more theatrical edge.

verse_1.lines: 두 눈 꼭 감아볼래?du nun kkok gamabollae? / 어떤 판타질 상상하든eotteon pantajil sangsanghadeun / 내가 다 이뤄줄게naega da irwojulge / 너는 그냥 꿈만 꾸면 돼neoneun geunyang kkumman kkumyeon dwae / 점점 커지는 silence (you know it)jeomjeom keojineun silence (you know it) / 아득히 너를 이끈 소리adeuki neoreul ikkeun sori
verse_1.literal: Will you try closing your eyes tightly? / whatever fantasy you imagine / I'll make it all come true / you just have to dream
verse_1.context: 판타지 (fantasy) framed as something she can grant, not just imagine, sets up the power dynamic of the whole song — she's positioned as the one in control of the dream, while the listener's only job is to surrender to it. -아/어 볼래? ('will you try to ~?') is a soft-sounding invitation that's actually the start of a very one-sided arrangement.

verse_2.lines: 원하면 끄덕여봐wonhamyeon kkeudeogyeobwa / 너는 깨어날 수 없을 걸neoneun kkae-eonal su eopseul geol / 너의 모든 것을 원해neoui modeun geoseul wonhae / 너라면 다, I want it all (X-O-X-Z)neoramyeon da, I want it all (X-O-X-Z) / 모조리 다, I want it all (X-O-X-Z)mojori da, I want it all (X-O-X-Z) / 더 못되게 더 착하게 더는deo motdoege deo chakage deoneun
verse_2.literal: The silence growing bigger and bigger / a sound that led you far away, faintly / if you want it, just nod / you won't be able to wake up
verse_2.context: 아득히 (adeuki) means distantly, faintly, as if from very far away — used for a sound or feeling that's disorienting rather than clear. 깨어날 수 없을 걸 ('you won't be able to wake up') turns the fantasy from something pleasant into something with no exit, the hypnosis/trance conceit taken to its logical conclusion.

chorus.lines: 노래를 따라와 날 찾아내 봐noraereul ttarawa nal chajanae bwa / Girls like this, 더는 없지Girls like this, deoneun eopji / Watch out, 괜히 다치지Watch out, gwaenhi dachiji / 너는 깨어날 수 없을 걸neoneun kkae-eonal su eopseul geol / 깨어나지 마, 순진한 건 됐으니, yeah, yeahkkae-eonaji ma, sunjinhan geon dwaesseuni, yeah, yeah / 너의 모든 것을 원해neoui modeun geoseul wonhae
chorus.literal: Give me the X, give me the O / give me the L-O-V-E / if it's from you, I want it all / give me the max, give me the top / give me the good energy / every last bit, I want it all
chorus.context: 모조리 다 (every single bit, without exception) intensifies the already maximal 'I want it all' — the chorus spells out X-O-X-Z almost like an incantation, letters standing in for affection the way you'd sign off a note, but repeated and demanded rather than freely given.

bridge.lines: 너라면 다, I want it all (X-O-X-Z)neoramyeon da, I want it all (X-O-X-Z) / 모조리 다, I want it all (X-O-X-Z)mojori da, I want it all (X-O-X-Z) / 넌 어때 날 믿니neon eottae nal minni / 난 너의 모든 걸nan neoui modeun geol / 꿈을 깨더라도 가져야겠어kkumeul kkaedeorado gajyeoyagesseo / 너라면 다, I want it all (X-O-X-Z)neoramyeon da, I want it all (X-O-X-Z) / 모조리 다, I want it all (X-O-X-Z)mojori da, I want it all (X-O-X-Z)
bridge.literal: Red lights, stop signs / what about you, do you trust me? / watch out, watch out / I want everything of yours / even if it means breaking the dream, I have to have it
bridge.context: 꿈을 깨더라도 (even if it means breaking/waking from the dream) is the sharpest line in the song — she's willing to shatter the fantasy she built if that's what it takes to actually possess what she wants, showing the desire underneath the hypnosis imagery is real, not just aesthetic.

artist_context: IVE, a Starship Entertainment girl group formed in 2021, built their run of hits (Love Dive, After Like, and others) around confident, self-assured concepts that frequently reference myth, fantasy, or desire as power. XOXZ continues that pattern, using dream/hypnosis imagery to frame romantic pursuit as something the narrator controls rather than something she's waiting for.
honorific_level: informal — 반말, addressed directly and commandingly to the listener

grammar_highlights.usage: 'Will you try to ~?' 감아볼래? — a soft invitation, here doubling as the start of a request for total surrender.
'Won't be able to ~, I bet.' 깨어날 수 없을 걸 — a confident prediction about someone else's inability to do something.
'Even if ~.' 꿈을 깨더라도 — 'even if it means breaking the dream' — expressing willingness to accept a cost to get what you want.
